correctness.rationale: Exact sampling density and three acute-angle dot-product tests reduce probability to two opposite-middle-sign patterns; other sign assignments and bounded extreme-gap strips are O_h(epsilon^2). The 8h(x)^2 product-region logarithmic area, sorting 6, sign probability 1/4, and f_epsilon -> 1/2 produce 3Q/2. A change of variables (u,v)=(epsilon^t,4epsilon^2 h(x)^2 w/epsilon^t), compact L1 convergence and controlled tails prove the product-marked total-variation law. Jensen and classical Berwald give sharp bounds with tent and plateau witnesses. Three million boundary-triplet trials per shape corroborate the parabola and tent values; computation is not the proof.
